'''Sta-Den Eekin''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Eekin was part of a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]], consisting of 200 [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], that was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was scheduled to be [[Death/Legends|executed]] after he was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Eekin was killed during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|rescue attempt]], which sparked the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Geonosis_arena.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Petranaki arena, where Eekin died]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], Sta-Den Eekin was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="IWSW" /> Eekin possessed the [[Force power/Legends|power]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|manipulate]] and cloud the minds of large crowds.<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="IWSW" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured and sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during a mission on the<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="IWSW" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assembled a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] consisting of 200 [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights, including Eekin, to rescue Kenobi from the Confederacy.<ref name="IWSW" />

Infiltrating the [[Petranaki arena]], the location of the execution, Eekin<ref name="IWSW" /> and his fellow Jedi revealed themselves by activating their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. In retaliation against the strike team's presence, [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|Geonosian warriors]] and Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|attacked]] the Jedi,<ref name="AOTC" /> sparking the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the opening engagement of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Eekin fought on the upper half of the arena's tribune, but his power to manipulate minds proved ineffective against the battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]],<ref name="IWSW" /> and the Klatooinian perished in the fight.<ref name="CSWE" /> Though the Jedi and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] won the battle,<ref name="AOTC" /> many Jedi similarly lost their lives.<ref name="IWSW" />

==Powers and abilities==
Eekin was able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to cloud the minds of large crowds. However, this ability proved to be useless on Geonosis, as he fought battle droids.<ref name="IWSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sta-Den Eekin was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', a [[2003]] reference book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="IWSW" />
